report_candidate_text: MCIPAC 与 Kadena 的公开规则把基地内私人组织置于“私人主体＋书面运作许可”的制度位置：组织不因此成为 MCCS／FSS 部门，command 的明确权限首先是准入与持续运作资格。
confirmed_scope: two local rule regimes and their generic/private-status clauses
missing_scope: named actor authorization instruments and regimes outside MCIPAC/Kadena
interpretation_limit: Do not replace this with a claim that the U.S. garrison organizes or controls private fundraising, personnel rotation or recipient networks
disconfirming_evidence: actor-specific instrument showing formal ownership, appointment, budget veto or internal operational control

report_candidate_text: 基地管理机关可以批准、监测、暂停或撤销组织在基地内运作的资格；Kadena 规则同时明文排除其对组织内部活动和结构的指挥，并将第四次文档违规原文规定为 ‘Dissolution of the PO’。本包保留该条款的原始强度，但尚未确认它是否实际执行，也未确认它在基地准入制度之外对法人存续产生何种效力。因此，准入治理、规则所称 dissolution 与组织控制应分别编码。
confirmed_scope: authorization, monitoring and sanction clauses; exact fourth-occurrence dissolution wording; explicit Kadena internal non-control clause
missing_scope: actor-specific exceptional governance instruments, actual sanction records and legal effect outside installation recognition/status
interpretation_limit: Do not reduce the express dissolution clause to operating-status revocation; do not expand it into an observed dissolution, proved legal-entity extinction, ownership, affiliation, political coordination or day-to-day internal control
disconfirming_evidence: formal instrument or execution record establishing the clause's legal mechanism/effect, or assigning command appointment, ownership, budget veto or internal decision rights

report_candidate_text: 公开规则呈现的是许可、条件支持与成本回收，而不是可以直接观察到的政府补贴：MCIPAC 对持续场地使用要求 license 和费用偿还，Kadena 对 18 FSS 设备、服务或支持按正常费用收费。
missing_scope: named rooms, invoices, fee waivers, actual support and payments
interpretation_limit: The claim concerns rule design only; it neither proves that every actor paid full cost nor rules out a separately documented lawful subsidy
disconfirming_evidence: actor-specific official record showing free or below-cost facility/support, waived fees or direct public funding

report_candidate_text: 持续零售例外为 thrift shop／gift shop 提供了一种规则承认的创收位置；Kadena 规则还具名列出两项配偶俱乐部零售业务。这个位置应与组织实际收入和资金流分开编码。
confirmed_scope: category exceptions and two raw named Kadena operations in the 2024 order
missing_scope: current status, identity of Kadena Enlisted vs X007, facility terms and revenue
interpretation_limit: Permission does not establish funding, monopoly, endorsement, free space, revenue size or legitimacy effects
disconfirming_evidence: later rule revoking the exception or actor-specific instrument changing the operation's status

report_candidate_text: 两套规则都要求私人组织持续提交治理与财务材料；Kadena 还明确要求为每个组织维护电子档案。它说明基地管理端存在 IRS 申报之外的行政记录流，但不说明任何具名档案已经取得或可以公开。
missing_scope: retention schedules, named files, completeness and public release status
interpretation_limit: The existence of a rule duty must not be turned into an acquisition promise, package completion condition or substantive finding about unseen contents
disconfirming_evidence: official superseding rule eliminating the reporting/file duty or evidence that the clause did not apply during the stated period

report_candidate_text: MCIPAC 与 Kadena 形成两条不同的地方准入与管理链；同属军属慈善生态的组织不能因此被画成一个统一 MCCS 层级。比较应并列规则制度与组织网络，而不是把二者压成一条 affiliation/control 边。
confirmed_scope: two local governance chains and their rule-defined roles
missing_scope: Navy/Army regimes and actor-specific authorization crosswalk
interpretation_limit: Different local chains do not prove autonomy from the wider DoD system and do not by themselves establish cross-regime organizational membership
disconfirming_evidence: formal cross-installation directive establishing a single operative authorization hierarchy for the selected private organizations
